Desk rules for paperwork queues in detail
Watching a visiting trainer is the best way to learn it

This page explains why the Companion Animal Travel Desk must keep animal files exact, calm, and ready for inspection. Every case affects boarding flow, welfare checks, and the service promise of Aurelia Skyways. New staff must treat each journey as a shared responsibility, because the desk protects both the traveler and the animal from avoidable delay.

Start with the document set. Check the reservation note, the travel declaration, and the welfare review before you accept the file. The welfare coordinator reviews animal comfort needs, and you must follow that guidance without improvising. If a rabbit is listed, place the health certificate in the file and confirm its current status before any handoff. <<FACT F082>> Do not separate the certificate from the main papers, and do not let the queue move forward until the record is complete.

Next, confirm the charge entry and make sure the customer sees a clear line on the receipt. <<FACT F058>> Keep your wording precise and neutral. If the traveler raises a concern, answer with the approved desk script and then pass the case to the senior coordinator when needed. Maintain a steady tone at the counter, because animal travel work can become tense when paperwork is incomplete or a crate inspection is pending.

Also check the crate label, feeding notes, and any comfort item listed for the journey. If the animal is restless, alert the welfare coordinator at once and do not guess at a remedy. The desk does not promise special handling beyond what the file allows, but it does ensure that every approved request is carried out cleanly and in order.

What to remember: complete records, calm handling, and exact handoff discipline keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk reliable.
